about.stop_the_program_on: Stop the program on this computer (the TV is not affected)

about.author: Author:
about.the_live_picture_and: The live picture and mouse use scrcpy (Genymobile, Apache-2.0). The remote buttons use the Android TV Remote protocol.
about.something_wrong_send_what: Something wrong? Send what was sent to the TV, what it answered and the errors (no pairing keys, MAC addresses or typed text). A bug report opens for you.
